finger.en: And finally, the expression fingers crossed is used to wish for hope or luck.
finger.zh: 最后，短语 fingers crossed 用于表达希望或祈求好运。

finger.en: Yes. We often make the physical gesture of crossing our fingers for good luck.
finger.zh: 是的。我们经常做出交叉手指的身体手势来祈求好运。

finger.en: You had to use your bare fingers, and it was slow, relentless work.
finger.zh: 你必须用光秃秃的手指去撕扯，这是一项缓慢而无情的工作。

finger.en: It was like his fingers. Every guitar, every time he strung the guitar was his fingers.

finding.en: One of the clearest findings is that money matters, but only up to a point.
finding.zh: 最明确的发现之一是金钱很重要，但只在一定程度上重要。

finding.en: Here, Cara shares her findings with Caroline Steel from BBC World Service's CrowdScience.
finding.zh: 在这里，Cara 与 BBC World Service 节目 CrowdScience 的 Caroline Steel 分享了她的发现。

finding.en: We'll be finding out what PTSD stands for at the end of the programme.
finding.zh: 我们将在节目结束时揭晓PTSD代表什么意思。

finding.en: Now, Milgram was at pains to clarify what his findings did not mean.
finding.zh: 不过，米尔格拉姆也一再费心澄清，他的研究结论并不意味着什么。

finding.en: Focus on finding things you enjoy, like things that you like doing, activities.
finding.zh: 专注于寻找你喜欢的东西，比如你喜欢做的事情，活动。

fix.en: But I have a fixed mindset in things like my musical and artistic ability.
fix.zh: 但在音乐和艺术能力等方面，我有着固定型思维。

fix.en: Here's reporter, Craig Langran, again for BBC World Service programme, People Fixing the World:
fix.zh: 下面再次是 BBC 世界服务频道节目《People Fixing the World》记者 Craig Langran 的报道：

fix.en: Time is so much more than this, though. It’s not a fixed universal system.
fix.zh: 不过，时间的意义远不止于此。它并不是一个固定且普适的系统。

fix.en: Many people believe that species were fixed creations, designed exactly as they appeared.
fix.zh: 许多人认为物种是固定不变的创造物，被设计成它们呈现出来的确切模样。

fix.en: Maybe poetry can't fix everything, but for Kat, it's making an impact for good.
fix.zh: 也许诗歌不能解决所有问题，但对卡特来说，它正在产生积极的影响。

figure.en: The physical presence of the authority figure, it turned out, was an important factor.
figure.zh: 事实证明，权威人物是否亲身在场，是一个重要因素。

figure.en: So…I just started, and figured I’d make it up as I went along.
figure.zh: 所以……我就直接开始了，想着边做边摸索。

figure.en: Not surprisingly, the Founding Fathers didn’t envision the Vice President as a powerful figure.
figure.zh: 毫不奇怪，开国元勋们并没有把副总统设想为一个有权有势的人物。

figure.en: They donate money to politicians. They are on friendly terms with influential government figures.
figure.zh: 他们向政治家捐款。他们与有影响力的政府人物保持着友好的关系。

figure.en: A ballpark figure is a phrase meaning a number which is an acceptably accurate approximation.
figure.zh: “ballpark figure”（大致数字）这个短语的意思是一个可以接受的准确近似值。

fisherman.en: Here, men traditionally work as rice farmers or fishermen, while women look after the home, the children and older people.
fisherman.zh: 在这里，传统上男性是稻农或渔民，而女性则照顾家庭、孩子和老人。

fisherman.en: But for a long time, Warsaw was just a modest community of fishermen and traders living behind the Vistula River.
fisherman.zh: 但在很长一段时间里，华沙只是维斯瓦河畔一个简朴的渔民和商人社区。

fisherman.en: I think that’s how you pronounce them. In some versions of the story, Wars was a fisherman and Sawa was a mermaid.
fisherman.zh: 我想他们是这么发音的。在故事的一些版本中，Wars 是一个渔民，而 Sawa 是一位人鱼。

fisherman.en: The first Europeans to explore the region of modern-day Canada extensively were fishermen, usually from countries like England, France, and Portugal.
fisherman.zh: 最早广泛探索现代加拿大地区的欧洲人是渔民，通常来自英国、法国和葡萄牙等国家。

fight.en: The fight response can make us belittle someone – make them feel inferior or unimportant.
fight.zh: 战斗反应会让我们贬低某人——让他们觉得自己低人一等或微不足道。

fight.en: Years passed. Hannibal’s army remained in Italy but was fighting a war of attrition.
fight.zh: 岁月流逝。Hannibal的军队虽然留在了意大利，但陷入了一场旷日持久的消耗战。

fight.en: Its citizens fought alongside Britain in World War I and later World War II.
fight.zh: 其公民与英国并肩作战，参加了第一次世界大战和后来的第二次世界大战。

fight.en: Although the Cold War did not begin with open fighting, it created constant pressure.
fight.zh: 虽然冷战并不是从公开的战斗开始的，但它造成了持续的压力。

fight.en: While technology can spread information, it can also help fight it when used responsibly.
fight.zh: 虽然技术可以传播信息，但如果使用得当，它也可以帮助打击虚假信息。

financial.en: This one ran safely for decades, and only closed in 2019, for ordinary financial reasons.
financial.zh: 这一个反应堆安全运行了数十年，直到2019年才因普通的财务原因关闭。

financial.en: That's the financial instrument that was central to this global credit crisis we're in.
financial.zh: 这就是对我们身处的这场全球信贷危机起决定性作用的金融衍生品。

financial.en: Wall Street refers to the economic center of New York, the financial district.
financial.zh: 华尔街指代纽约的经济中心、金融区。

financial.en: T he final nail in the coffin was the global financial crisis in 2008/2009.
financial.zh: 党政最后的一抻是 2008年至 2009 年的全球金融卅机。

financial.en: Joining the EU has often meant access to new markets and investment and financial support.
financial.zh: 加入欧盟通常意味着能够进入新的市场、获得投资和财政支持。

fiction.en: One is Border Districts. The other Stream System-- The Collected Short Fiction of Gerald Murnane.
fiction.zh: 一部是《边境地区》。另一部是《溪流系统——Gerald Murnane短篇小说集》。

fiction.en: Maybe interactive fiction that changes based on decisions in the book.
fiction.zh: 也许是根据书中的决定而改变的互动小说。

fiction.en: Barely read a fiction book in years. It's like more news.
fiction.zh: 好几年几乎没读过小说。就像是更多的新闻。

fiction.en: Don Quixote tells the story of a man who becomes obsessed with medieval knight stories and begins confusing fiction with reality.
fiction.zh: 《堂吉诃德》讲述了一个痴迷于中世纪骑士故事并开始将虚构与现实混淆的男人的故事。

fiction.en: To some, it seems like science fiction, a fixation on looking to space while we have more than enough problems to deal with back on Earth.
fiction.zh: 在有些人看来，这就像是科幻小说，是一门只会仰望星空、却对地球上亟待解决的成堆问题视而不见的执念。

fibre.en: So, could our modern obsession with protein mean that we ignore other important food groups, like fibre?
fibre.zh: 那么，我们对蛋白质的现代痴迷是否意味着我们忽略了其他重要的食物类别，比如纤维？

fibre.en: Dr Karan also gives some hacks – good solutions or pieces of advice – to help boost your fibre intake.
fibre.zh: Karan博士还给出了一些“hacks”——好的解决方法或建议——来帮助提高你的纤维摄入量。

fibre.en: It tells our bodies to get ready for the raw and rough fibre needed to develop our chewing muscles and teeth.
fibre.zh: 它告诉我们的身体准备好迎接发育咀嚼肌和牙齿所需的生硬纤维。

fibre.en: Tough fibres soften. And cooked food releases anywhere between 30 and 100 percent more calories than the same food eaten raw.
fibre.zh: 坚韧的纤维变软了。而且煮熟的食物释放的热量比生吃同样的食物多出 30% 到 100%。

fibre.en: One of the most common tasks given to women and children was unpicking old rope, separating the fibres so it could be used again.
fibre.zh: 分派给妇女和儿童最常见的任务之一是拆解旧绳索，把纤维拆散以便重新使用。

finance.en: So in this whole process, what's the first time someone looked at your finances?
finance.zh: 所以在整个购房过程中，历史上第一次有人真正审查你的财务状况是什么时候？

finance.en: And the reason is: The taxes were imposed to finance Britain's colonization of Bengal.
finance.zh: 原因是：征收这些税，是为了给英国对孟加拉的殖民统治提供资金。

finance.en: Now, the study investigated six areas of life, including health, finances, social relationships and religion.
finance.zh: 该研究调查了生活的六个领域，包括健康、财务、社会关系和宗教。

finance.en: Singapore is now a major center for finance, shipping, aviation, technology, international business.
finance.zh: 新加坡现在是金融、航运、航空、科技和国际商业的重要中心。

finance.en: The same diamonds that financed Botswana’s development fueled conflict in Sierra Leone.
finance.zh: 为博茨瓦纳发展提供资金的同一批钻石，却在塞拉利昂点燃了冲突。

fireman.en: They don't wear firemen's helmets, but these four-legged, fire-fighting friends are really coming to the rescue in Spain.
fireman.zh: 它们虽然不戴消防员头盔，但这些四条腿的'消防员'朋友，确实正在西班牙发挥着救援的作用。

fireman.en: Well, now I have a picture in my head of a cow wearing a fireman's helmet, but I guess that's not what you mean, Neil.
fireman.zh: 这下我脑海里浮现出一头戴着消防员头盔的奶牛，不过我猜这不是你的意思吧，Neil。

fireman.en: That’s why similar patterns started to appear in very different places; a fireman in Paris was now no longer bidding for a property against the local greengrocer, schoolteacher, and wedding photographer, but against sophisticated international investors.
fireman.zh: 这就是为什么非常不同的地方开始出现类似的模式；巴黎的一名消防员现在不再是与当地的蔬菜商、学校老师和婚礼摄影师竞拍房产，而是与成熟的国际投资者竞争。

filter.en: To filter something out means to remove or separate something unwanted from something else.
filter.zh: 过滤掉某物意味着将不需要的东西从其他东西中移除或分离出来。

filter.en: If you filter something out, you remove or separate something unwanted from a substance.
filter.zh: 如果你过滤掉某物，你就是从一种物质中移除或分离出不需要的东西。

filter.en: Information started to spread instantly and globally without filters or fact checking.
filter.zh: 信息开始在没有过滤或事实核查的情况下，在全球范围内即时传播。

filter.en: And it’s the MP’s job to take these concerns to parliament, through some sort of filtering system, of course.
filter.zh: 把这些关切带到议会去就是议员的工作，当然，这需要通过某种过滤系统。

fission.en: And regulators in the US have started treating fusion as a properly separate category from traditional nuclear power, with lighter rules, because a fusion reactor can't melt down the way a fission reactor can.
fission.zh: 美国的监管机构已开始将核聚变视为与传统核能完全不同的类别，并适用更宽松的规则，因为核聚变反应堆不会像裂变反应堆那样发生熔毁。

filth.en: The dog is lying in piles of filth, and covered in fleas.
filth.zh: 那条狗躺在一堆污物中，身上布满了跳蚤。

filth.en: There were many institutions in England where the mentally ill were treated far, far worse: chained to walls, exhibited to the public, or simply left to rot in their own filth.
filth.zh: 当时英格兰有许多机构，精神病患者在那里受到的待遇要糟糕得多：用铁链锁在墙上、向公众展示，或者任由他们在自己的污秽中腐烂。

firework.en: Fireworks. Services of thanksgiving in churches across the country, and a grand ceremony at St Paul’s Cathedral.
firework.zh: 烟花。全国各地教堂的感恩礼拜，以及在圣保罗大教堂举行的盛大仪式。

fireplace.en: It was the oldest known fireplace in the world.
fireplace.zh: 这是世界上已知最古老的炉灶。

fierce.en: The Soviet army had reached Berlin and fierce fighting took place on the city streets.
fierce.zh: 苏联军队已经抵达柏林，激烈的战斗在城市街道上展开。

fierce.en: The competition is fierce, and trends in the perfume industry change rapidly.
fierce.zh: 竞争异常激烈，香水行业的潮流瞬息万变。

fierce.en: The Iberians, from what is now Spain, were fierce and mobile, and were especially suited to mountainous terrain.
fierce.zh: 来自今西班牙的伊比利亚人凶猛且机动性强，特别适合山地作战。

fierce.en: The reaction was fierce. For many people, especially in journalism and the arts, the conviction was an outrage.
fierce.zh: 社会反应极其强烈。对许多人来说，尤其是新闻界和艺术界，这次定罪简直是骇人听闻。

fierce.en: Britain and France were fierce rivals at this time.
fierce.zh: 当时英国和法国是死敌。

fighter.en: He was photographed riding horses shirtless, diving into icy waters, and piloting fighter jets.
fighter.zh: 镜头记录下他赤膊骑马、冬泳以及驾驶战斗机的画面。

fighter.en: In 1943, Jewish fighters inside the ghetto launched what became known as the Warsaw Ghetto Uprising.
fighter.zh: 1943 年，犹太人区内的抵抗战士发起了后来被称为华沙犹太人区起义的行动。

fighter.en: On August 1st, 1944, thousands of resistance fighters launched attacks across the city.
fighter.zh: 1944 年 8 月 1 日，数千名抵抗战士在全城各地发动了袭击。

fighter.en: It first gained international attention for its role in Ukraine, where its fighters were involved in key battles in the Donbas region.
fighter.zh: 它因在乌克兰的角色而首次获得国际关注，其武装人员参与了顿巴斯地区的关键战役。

fighter.en: There is evidence of mercenary fighters all over the world and throughout history: Ancient Persia, Carthage, Qin Dynasty China, and Ancient Egypt.
fighter.zh: 有证据表明，雇佣兵在世界各地和整个历史上都存在：古代波斯、迦太基、中国秦朝和古埃及。

firm.en: We get an email from a street firm-- I don't know, just say Credit Suisse First Boston.
firm.zh: 我们收到了来自一家华尔街公司的邮件——我不知道，就说是瑞士信贷第一波士顿吧。

firm.en: I've seen photographs of the moment. He's looking me in the eye and giving me a firm handshake.
firm.zh: 我见过那一刻的照片。他直视着我的眼睛，用力地和我握手。

firm.en: The small bank sells the mortgage to a guy like Mike at a big investment firm on Wall Street.
firm.zh: 小银行再把抵押贷款卖给华尔街大型投资公司的 Mike 这样的家伙。

firm.en: The technology firms at the top of these global systems?
firm.zh: 处于这些全球系统顶端的科技公司？

firm.en: He owns a private security firm, which holds contracts to protect South African-funded hotels that are being built on the islands.
firm.zh: 他拥有一家私人保安公司，接下了保护岛上正在兴建的南非资助酒店的合同。

fist.en: For three decades, Mubarak ruled the country with an iron fist, using the military and security forces to suppress opposition and maintain control over the population.
fist.zh: 三十年来，Mubarak 以铁腕统治着这个国家，利用军队和安全部队来压制反对派并维持对民众的控制。

fist.en: He fought in Iraq, Afghanistan, and elsewhere, and has now has written a book called The Heart and the Fist: The Education of a Humanitarian, the Making of a Navy SEAL.
fist.zh: 他在伊拉克、阿富汗和其他地方战斗过，现在写了一本名为《心与拳：一个人道主义者的教育，一个海豹突击队员的炼成》（The Heart and the Fist: The Education of a Humanitarian, the Making of a Navy SEAL）的书。

fist.en: In part one, today’s episode, we are going to learn about Mobutu Sese Seko, the man who ruled the Democratic Republic of Congo with an iron fist and a leopard-skin hat.
fist.zh: 在今天的第一集里，我们将了解 Mobutu Sese Seko，这个用铁腕和豹皮帽统治刚果民主共和国的男人。

fist.en: He simply didn’t care what Roman high society thought about him; he threw money hand over fist at the Praetorian guard and knew that this money assured loyalty, and therefore protection.
fist.zh: 他根本不在乎罗马上流社会对他的看法；他大手大脚地把钱砸给禁卫军，并且知道这些钱能确保忠诚，从而确保安全。

fitting.en: It was not an auspicious start to the campaign, but the song was a fitting message.
fitting.zh: 这不是一个吉利的竞选开端，但这首歌传达的信息却很贴切。

filament.zh: 我想把哈耶克也拉进来——你刚才说到技术与创新的扩散，或者在这个例子里更准确地说是发明的扩散——正是这种扩散让灯丝相对于鲸脂能带来照明——没错——我以前好像从没这么想过，但按你之前的框架来说——就像我们一直在讨论的必然性与能动性之争——如果你想想诺德豪斯的这个洞见，照明的价格随着时间推移持续下降：这其实是一种“自发秩序／看不见的手”式的论证。
